grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Weekend Trip to Hangzhou
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。判断题请选择“正确”、“错误”或“未提及”。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage: Last Friday, Li Ming and his wife, Wang Fang, took a train to Hangzhou. They left Shanghai at 7:00 a.m. and arrived at 8:30 a.m. The train was fast and clean. After they got off the train, they took a taxi to their hotel. The hotel was near West Lake. They checked in and left their bags in the room. Then they walked to West Lake. The weather was sunny and warm. They walked around the lake for two hours. After that, they had lunch at a small restaurant. They ate fish and rice. The food was delicious. In the afternoon, they visited a tea museum. They learned about Chinese tea. Finally, they went back to the hotel and rested. On Saturday, they rented bikes and rode along the lake. They took many photos. In the evening, they watched a show about the lake. The show was beautiful. On Sunday morning, they bought some tea and silk. Then they took a train back to Shanghai. They arrived home at 6:00 p.m. They were tired but happy. The trip was short but wonderful. They hope to visit Hangzhou again next year. They also want to try the local food next time. They think Hangzhou is a great place for a short holiday. Many people in Shanghai like to go there for the weekend. It is easy to travel by train. The trains are fast and comfortable. Li Ming and Wang Fang enjoyed their trip very much. They told their friends about it. Their friends want to go to Hangzhou too.

grammar.title: 一般过去时
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加-ed，例如：walk → walked, visit → visited。不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，例如：go → went, take → took, eat → ate, buy → bought。使用then, after that, finally等词可以使叙述更连贯。
grammar.example: They walked around the lake for two hours. After that, they had lunch at a small restaurant.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：Yesterday, I ______ to the park.
questions.explanation: go的过去式是went，是不规则变化。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：She ______ a book last night.
questions.explanation: read的过去式仍是read，但发音为/red/。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：We ______ dinner at 7:00.
questions.explanation: have的过去式是had，是不规则变化。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：They ______ a movie yesterday.
questions.explanation: see的过去式是saw，是不规则变化。
